result.summary: Found 1 issue: a broken delivery fee value is rendered on a restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, so a failed numeric calculation is leaking directly into the UI.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery fee before rendering and never show NaN; fall back to a computed amount or a friendly placeholder such as 'Delivery fee unavailable', and log the calculation error.
